name: subagent-router
description: Moves the built-in Explore and general-purpose subagents to a cheaper model when a small Haiku call finds their task only locates things (reading tasks too, if you turn that route on), and starts in an observe mode that records what it would do and changes nothing

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe records what would be routed and changes nothing; route acts; off does nothing.

locatingRoute.title: Locating route
locatingRoute.description: Model for tasks that only locate things: haiku, sonnet, or parent to leave them alone.

readingRoute.title: Reading route
readingRoute.description: Model for read-and-summarise tasks. Off (parent) by default: Sonnet was less complete in 17 of 20 measured reading tasks and wrong in 1.
